name: Seals of the Sin'dorei
summary: Rimtori's officers may carry three seals needed for the Sin'dorei spell. You bring them to the Tome of Summoning, where their marks can be checked against its text.

sections.title: Three Marks
sections.body: The Tome of Summoning lies open before you, detailing Rimtori's spell. You are asked to bring it the Seal of the Warden, Seal of the Warrior, and Seal of the Ranger. Their marks are said to suit different kinds of skill, and Rimtori's officers may be carrying them. The seals matter to the spell taking shape around the crystals.

sections.title: The Tome's Signs
sections.body: At the tome, you see that each seal matches the marks described in its pages. The crystals answer with a pulsing power, and the sight puts a reckless idea in your mind.

faq.q: What seals does the tome need?
faq.answer: The Tome of Summoning is to receive the Seal of the Warden, Seal of the Warrior, and Seal of the Ranger.

faq.q: What does each seal look like?
faq.answer: The first crystal's seal bears a sword, the middle crystal's a glaive, and the last crystal's a talon.

faq.q: Who can channel the first seal?
faq.answer: The sword-marked seal's energy calls for an expert warrior.

faq.q: Who can channel the middle seal?
faq.answer: The glaive-marked seal's energy calls for someone skilled in both martial and magical arts.

faq.q: Who can channel the last seal?
faq.answer: The talon-marked seal's energy calls for someone at home in the wilds.

faq.q: Why take the seals from Rimtori's officers?
faq.answer: The seals may be carried by Rimtori's officers to aid her spell, so taking them would trouble her.

attribution: In-game quest text: Seals of the Sin'dorei
